text: 证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，进一步深化制度包容性适应性研究。资本市场作为市场化资源配置的重要平台，要进一步研究深化投融资综合改革，加快构建适应创新规律、产业规律的直接融资体系，统筹发挥私募市场与公开市场、股票市场与债券市场的协同功能，尤其是要在科学把握节奏的同时，加强对大型和新型科技企业发行上市的制度适配性和风险应对机制研究。同时，要全面准确理解新质生产力发展的科学内涵，深入研究支持新型消费、传统产业升级等不同领域优质企业上市发展，不断改善和优化上市公司结构，促进市场均衡协调发展。
text_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that research on the inclusiveness and adaptability of systems should be further deepened. As an important platform for market-based resource allocation, the capital market should further study and deepen comprehensive investment and financing reform, accelerate the building of a direct financing system that adapts to innovation and industrial patterns, and coordinate the synergistic functions of the private market and the public market and of the stock market and the bond market. In particular, while scientifically grasping the pace, it is necessary to strengthen research on institutional adaptability and risk-response mechanisms for the issuance and listing of large and new-type technology enterprises. At the same time, it is necessary to fully and accurately understand the scientific connotation of the development of new quality productive forces, conduct in-depth research on supporting the listing and development of high-quality enterprises in different fields such as new consumption and traditional industrial upgrading, continuously improve and optimize the structure of listed companies, and promote balanced and coordinated market development.
